purpose: Fresh frozen holdout written after the v1/v2 prompt error analysis on holdout v1, and BEFORE prompt v3 was ever run. Holdout v1 has now informed prompt design, so this set replaces it as the clean test for prompt v3 and later. Do not tune prompts on it.
labelling_conventions: Confirm requires the sender to agree the visit goes ahead; a bare agreement ('yes', a thumbs-up) counts.
A thank-you alone, or news about someone else's delay (provider, driver), is Unclear: it does not say whether the visit is on.
Questions, complaints, requests for information and non-committal replies are Unclear.
No Response only for empty or whitespace-only messages.
limitations: Synthetic messages authored by the project developer, not sampled from real families.
39 cases: small; differences of 1-2 cases are not statistically meaningful.
Written with knowledge of earlier failure modes, so it over-represents boundary cases by design.
